Strategy: Spread preference: score by the distance between a bin's residual and the mean of all feasible residuals, so the item goes to the most extreme bin, either the tightest or the roomiest, while typical middle bins are preserved for later. It can fail when extremes are poor choices and the middle bins were the efficient ones.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    return [abs(r - m) for r in bins]
```
